# PDF dependency

`pdf-lib.min.js` is the browser UMD bundle of **pdf-lib 1.17.1**, distributed under the MIT license in `pdf-lib.LICENSE.md`.

Source and API documentation: https://pdf-lib.js.org/ and https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib.

The bundle is stored locally so exporting results needs no network request or server. `results.js` builds the report and downloads the PDF in the browser.
